text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyah-ha-ha-ha!
Kris S, you are strong!
Perhaps even stronger than myself!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: That is precisely why—you cannot defeat me!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: What!? Just because they're strong—we can't win?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! The strong never doubt themselves!
And in the end, they get the rug pulled right out from under them.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Still, I place no trust in others. I trust no one. Not even myself!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hence, there is no complacency.
You're thinking it, aren't you?
"With my legs, I can bring them down."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"That is sheer arrogance!
HYAAAAAAAH!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
No Reason slashes through! Slashes through!
Musterng her final ounce of strength, she cuts right through the formidable rivals!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What an absolute trickster,
standing at the pinnacle this year!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyah-ha-ha!
Symboli Kris S, what of it?
The Silent Clan, what of it?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Peerless throughout history!
No Reason is right hereee!!

A GⅠ featuring Senior Class competitors.
No Reason delivered a brilliant preemptive strike heading into next year.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, though I managed to win...
Kris S, thou art truly not one to be underestimated.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Next year, when you enter the Senior Year—
you naturally intend to claim supremacy over the realm, do you not?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
I... came to change the racing world of this country.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: That is—my mission.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, change the racing world, you say?
You truly are a dreadnought-class Black Ship.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
That makes it all the more worth fighting.
However, compared to that—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
How pathetic the Clan of Silence is.
To think they've sent such a meager force to the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Knocking those guys down a peg might be surprisingly easy after all! Nya-ha-ha!

No Reason burst out laughing heartily.
However—
(Vroom!)

There was a lone shadow
gazing intently at the sight.

An Umamusume of the Clan of Silence.
Currently in her Junior year, she has already secured a victory and entered an Open-class race.
And furthermore—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
That was an amazing race, Uni-san!
This year was packed with legendary Umamusume, after all.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
If only I could run alongside someone so powerful.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
If only I could catch it, sink my teeth into it,
and suck it dry to the very marrow...! Ahh...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: S-Still-san...???

"Zenno Rob Roy, the book-loving Umamusume.
Still in Love, the Umamusume with two sides."

All of them belong to the same generation as Neo Universe and are Uma Musume with very promising futures.
What's more, both of them...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The clan of silence, huh...
I see. The next generation is rising up, one after another...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Good grief, we were short-handed today, but the tide of the era seems far from forgiving, hmm.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
From next year onward, I'll be completely surrounded by enemies...
It looks like it will force me into quite a grueling struggle, but...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: No worries, I'll change even a fate like that!
And so, we held a strategy meeting for the coming year.
choice_data_list: The older generation is strong, but... the younger one looks strong too...
The older generation is strong, but the younger one looks strong too, huh...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, but fear not.
Indeed, the quiet stars of ill omen
are ascending to the heavens one after another, but...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
There is still time before they grow into their own.
Besides, who could possibly know the fate that awaits beyond that?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: In fact, you and I overcame countless hardships to stand right here, did we not?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Now then! Next year will finally be the Senior Class. To truly conquer the realm—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Which race are we heading to next, Trainer?

"To make an even bigger name for ourselves, we should run
the Spring Grand Prix following the winter one.
In that case—"
choice_data_list: Let's head to the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, 2200m in late spring, is it?
The level of attention will be unrivaled!
Splendid, truly splendid!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Or before that, it might be wise to enter the 3,200m Tenno Sho (Spring) to prove that she can handle long distances as well.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Running the Kikuka Sho without merely chasing
Lord Kris S's tail... Methinks that experience shall serve me well!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Indeed! Being able to take a detour is truly the height of luxury!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now, raise your head, Trainer.
Above us is a sky full of stars!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Unification of the realm next year!
The one who rules the Twinkle Series
for generations to come is none other than I!
